reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 32 original low-typing questions: independently checked complete German, every offered distractor, answer keys, verb valency and cases, bilingual explanations and hints, and distinct scenarios. 16 authored, 4 deferred. Clarified bedürfen plus genitive, begegnen plus dative, begleiten plus accusative, beauftragen versus Auftraggeber, neutral beeinflussen versus harmful beeinträchtigen, and behaupten versus beweisen. Conflicting bedienen card-game source was deferred. Human editorial review, CEFR certification and rights clearance remain outstanding; publicationApproved=false.
